messages:
maria-support: Heads up — customer (Shoply) hit a big p95 regression on /v1/rerank today during their morning peak. p95 went from ~1.2s -> ~4.8s and we're seeing intermittent 504s. request_id=shoply-abc123-20260316T14:23

alan-rerank: Any change on their side? new model or larger candidate lists? payload size?

maria-support: They sent over a sample. It's a rerank call with ~280 candidates in one batch. Minimal metadata. Quick repro curl they gave:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"query":"find similar items","candidates":["id1","id2",... ~280 ids ...]}'
```
They said retries were enabled client-side (3x).

ingrid-ml: 280 candidates is large — rerank scoring is O(N) on candidates and some model variants do additional cross-attention that kills latency at scale. Which model variant are they hitting? v2-ranker-quant or unquantized?

maria-support: They didn't pin version. Backend shows routing to ranker-v2 (appears quantized).

sre-bot: [automated] gateway/edge cluster reports spike 2026-03-16T14:22:30-14:26:00 with increased 504 counts on route /v1/rerank. Circuitbreaker tripped on ranker-pool-3 at 14:24:12.

devex-jordan: Short-term mitigation: ask customer to limit candidates to <=100 and disable client retries while we triage. Also suggest retry-with-backoff instead of immediate 3x.

maria-support: I asked them to reduce to 50 and disable retries — they did. 504s disappeared immediately but p95 still sits ~1.6s (better than 4.8s but still above their SLA). They need this fixed quickly.

ops-luca: Can we repro with a load test? I can kick a k6 job hitting the same payload shapes and candidate counts. If it reproduces, we can check kernel-side hot paths and batch behavior.

alan-rerank: Good call. Also checking gateway timeout configuration: defaults are fairly generous, but when a backend is slow and client retries are enabled, we get thundering herd. We should verify our router doesn't send multiple concurrent requests for the same upstream for retries (avoid retry storm).

ingrid-ml: I'll run a local rerank with the sample payload and profiling enabled. Hypothesis: tokenization + cross-attention on 280 candidates creates massive KV cache churn and serialization overhead. Might be an opportunity for prefix caching or early embedding prefilter.

maria-support: Here's a small excerpt from their HTTP logs:

```
[14:24:11] request_id=shoply-abc123 backend=ranker-v2 duration_ms=4930 status=504
[14:24:12] request_id=shoply-abc123 backend=ranker-v2 duration_ms=5021 status=504 (retry)
```

devex-jordan: Thanks. For immediate relief we can add a per-tenant hard limit on candidates (eg 200) and surface a clearer 413-like response with suggested remediation. That avoids silent 504s.

alan-rerank: I'll take this as action item to look at: (1) reproduce under k6 with 280 candidates + client retries, (2) run with profiler to confirm KV/cross-attn hotspot, (3) propose runtime config change to enforce soft candidate caps and smarter retry logic. If we confirm a kernel-level perf regression, escalate to eng-runtime.

sre-bot: [automated] created incident INC-2026-1478 for rerank p95 spike — assigned to alan-rerank and ops-luca.

ops-luca: K6 job queued: loadtest/rerank-shoply-177700. Will post results link when done.

ingrid-ml: One more ask — can you attach a sanitized sample payload (actual candidate ids ok to hash) and the full trace id from the gateway so I can join traces across services?

maria-support: Uploaded sanitized payload + gateway trace id to the incident doc: https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-1478 (link internal). Trace id: trace-shoply-77a1.

alan-rerank: I'll review traces now. Quick note: if the customer depends on large candidate sets, long-term fix is a prefilter step using embeddings to bring candidate count down before rerank. We'll propose as product best-practice.

maria-support: Customer wants ETA. Can we aim to have a mitigation plan (config + docs) in 8 hours and a follow-up for eng-runtime if kernel change needed within 72 hours?

alan-rerank: Yes — I'll post a triage summary and proposed mitigation in 8 hours. If profiling shows deeper runtime perf, we'll escalate. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [automated] deployed rate-limiter patch to gateway-canary at 14:52 — soft candidate cap experiment enabled (limit=200)

maria-support: Thanks everyone — notifying Shoply and will keep thread updated with customer feedback.

ops-luca: Loadtest results: reproduces p95 spike at ~250+ candidates. Link: https://perf.redwood/load/rerank-shoply-177700 (internal)

alan-rerank: Follow-up plan: write up config change to enforce per-tenant candidate cap, update SDK docs to recommend embedding prefilter, and schedule eng-runtime deep dive if profiler confirms kernel-level hotspots. Will close incident after customer validation.

maria-support: Appreciated — I'll coordinate customer's validation window tomorrow morning.
